content.value_statement: Database schema changes can break deployments, data integrity, or rollback paths. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through reversible, versioned, and zero-downtime migration work.
actual_capabilities: Identify when a task needs a database migration.
Guide creation of migration files for schema changes.
Support adding, modifying, and removing tables or columns.
Review index creation and deletion plans.
Plan reversible down methods and rollback behavior.
Separate schema migrations from data migrations.
limitations: Does not include framework-specific migration commands in this package.
Relies on a referenced standards file that may not be packaged with the skill.
Cannot validate live database state or production locks by itself.
Does not replace DBA review for high-risk migrations.

use_cases.title: Add a Safe Schema Change
use_cases.description: Plan a new table, column, or index with rollback steps and deployment impact checks.

use_cases.title: Review Migration Readiness
use_cases.description: Check a proposed migration for reversibility, locking risk, and data migration separation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Rollback
use_cases.description: Map migration rollback behavior before a release that changes database structure.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Migration Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to create a checklist for adding a database column safely. Include rollback and deployment checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reversible Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to design a reversible migration for this schema change: [describe change].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Zero-Downtime Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to plan a zero-downtime rollout for this migration: [describe migration and traffic pattern].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Migration Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to review these migration requirements for locking, rollback, ordering, and data integrity risks.

output_examples.input: Add a nullable status column to orders.
output_examples.output: A migration plan with an additive column change, rollback notes, deployment order, and verification checks.

output_examples.input: Create an index on a high-traffic table.
output_examples.output: A review that highlights lock risk, online index creation needs, rollback behavior, and production timing concerns.

output_examples.input: Split a user full_name column into first_name and last_name.
output_examples.output: A staged migration approach that separates schema changes, backfill planning, application compatibility, and final cleanup.

best_practices: Prefer additive schema changes before removing or renaming existing fields.
Define rollback behavior before applying a migration.
Keep data migrations separate from structural schema migrations.
anti_patterns: Combining destructive schema changes with application rollout in one step.
Creating indexes on large tables without lock and runtime planning.
Writing migrations that cannot be reversed or safely retried.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan, create, and review database schema migrations for backend systems.

faq.question: Does it run migrations automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for migration design, review, rollback, and deployment planning.

faq.question: Can it support zero-downtime deployments?
faq.answer: Yes. It prompts for backwards compatibility, staged rollout, and lock risk considerations.

faq.question: Does it handle data migrations?
faq.answer: It advises separating data migrations from schema migrations and planning each path carefully.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should be reviewed before publishing this skill?
faq.answer: The parent-directory reference should be replaced with packaged documentation or direct instructions.
